title: CLTR Cutover Certification record
description: Phase 136N, Implementation Group 4. Shape-only wire contract for a Certification companion record (CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 v1.0 Sec.23). A Certification document is evidence-based verification of a specific CutoverCandidate; it never itself proves certification authenticity, publishes authority, activates cutover, or establishes current authority (Sec.1, Sec.40). Legacy lifecycle remains the sole production authority; CLTR remains derivative. Tier 1 (strict): additionalProperties: false, no _extensions escape hatch (Sec.14). authority_role 'authoritative' is locally forbidden (Sec.9's 12-file list includes certification). Separation from HumanAuthorization (Sec.13 of the phase objective): this record deliberately carries no named certifier-principal field the way human_authorization.schema.json carries 'principal' -- Sec.23's frozen field table names no such field; certification is evidence-based verification (verifier_evidence, an array of record_reference) rather than a single named human decision, a documented design distinction from human_authorization's principal-centric shape (disclosed as NON-BLOCKING-136N-8; a prompt-suggested 'certifier_principal' field is not present in the frozen contract and is not invented here).

schema_id.description: Always present. Identifies this document as validated against the Certification schema.

schema_version.description: Always present. This file's own MAJOR.MINOR version.

contract_version.description: Always present. CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 version this schema was generated against.

record_type.description: Always present. Fixed family tag for this record type.

record_id.description: Always present. Shape-checked only; never recomputed at Layer 2.

record_digest.description: Always present. Digest of this document itself. Shape-checked only; never recomputed at Layer 2.

created_at.description: Always present. Never used to establish record identity or ordering across documents.

phase_id.description: Always present. certification is one of the families requiring phase_id (Sec.7.2).

migration_epoch.description: Always present. Every companion record binds to exactly one migration epoch (Sec.7.2, CSCH-INV-1).

candidate_reference.description: Always present. Family-tagged reference to the CutoverCandidate this certification verifies. A valid reference never implies the referenced candidate exists or matches (Layer 4).

request_reference.description: Always present. Family-tagged reference to the originating CutoverRequest.

readiness_reference.description: Always present. Family-tagged reference to the originating ReadinessPackage.

authorization_reference.description: Always present. Family-tagged reference to the governing HumanAuthorization. Certification does not itself authorize -- it verifies a candidate that was already authorized (Sec.13 of the phase objective's separation requirement).

source_authority_reference.description: Always present. Family-tagged reference to the source (legacy) AuthorityEpoch.

target_epoch_reference.description: Always present. Family-tagged reference to the proposed target AuthorityEpoch. Sec.23 does not forbid source_authority_reference and target_epoch_reference from referencing an identical epoch record; no such restriction is invented here.

cas_expectation.description: Always present (Sec.23). Every expected-state field within this embedded component is itself unconditionally required (Sec.24).

verifier_evidence.description: Always present as a key; may be empty. Array of record_reference evidence entries this certification's verification result is based on. No family restriction is applied, matching the readiness_package.evidence_references precedent (Sec.20) -- an evidence entry may point at any of the 16 companion record_family values.

state.description: Always present. Record-local CertificationState (Sec.8.8, 4 values). 'stale' requires staleness; 'invalidated' requires invalidation (both enforced below). A 'certified' value here never itself proves certification authenticity (Layer 4).

staleness.description: Conditionally present: required iff state is 'stale', forbidden otherwise.

invalidation.description: Conditionally present: required iff state is 'invalidated', forbidden otherwise.

authority_disclosure.description: Always present. authority_role 'authoritative' is locally forbidden on this record (Sec.9's 12-file list); is_authoritative remains const false per the shared definition regardless. A valid Certification record never itself publishes or activates authority.

candidate_reference.description: A record_reference locally restricted to record_family 'cutover_candidate', with schema_id/schema_version unconditionally required (Sec.12 cross-family rule).

request_reference.description: A record_reference locally restricted to record_family 'cutover_request', with schema_id/schema_version unconditionally required.

readiness_reference.description: A record_reference locally restricted to record_family 'readiness_package', with schema_id/schema_version unconditionally required.

authorization_reference.description: A record_reference locally restricted to record_family 'human_authorization', with schema_id/schema_version unconditionally required. Preventing a candidate, certification, or any other family from being substituted for the authorization binding (Sec.13 family-substitution requirement).

epoch_reference.description: A record_reference locally restricted to record_family 'authority_epoch', used for both source_authority_reference and target_epoch_reference.

detected_at.description: Always present when this object is present.

reason_code.description: Always present when this object is present.

staleness.description: Bounded local staleness-disclosure object. Present only when state is 'stale'.

invalidated_at.description: Always present when this object is present.

reason_code.description: Always present when this object is present.

invalidation.description: Bounded local invalidation-disclosure object. Present only when state is 'invalidated'.
